scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Ex-Servicemen In Penury
other_conditions: Must be a non-pensioner ex‑serviceman (ESM) up to the rank of Havildar/equivalent from the Navy, Army or Air Force, or their widow.
Applicant (ESM) or widow must be 65 years old on 1 April of the financial year when applying (widow age condition waived if applying after the death of the ESM).
Must not be receiving any other pension, income, or financial assistance from the state government or any other source.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of Rs.4000 per month, paid annually to eligible ex‑servicemen or their widows.
